答案格式：第1问====第2问", "canonical_answer": "[[35]]====[[55]]", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "[[3\sqrt{7}====无解]]", "certificate": "(9①2)=\sqrt9+2^2=7，(4①1)=\sqrt4+1^2=3，因此 7②3=\sqrt7\times3=3\sqrt7。另有 1②(X①3)=\sqrt1(\sqrt X+3^2)=\sqrt X+9=8，故需 \sqrt X=-1；在实数范围内无解。"}]}
